The campaign aimed to weaken Ukraine’s position, split Western allies and secure more favorable terms for Moscow. title: The multiplier effect: How authoring tools can transform web accessibility
summary: In this post, W3C's Web Accessibility Initiative (WAI) Director Shawn Lawton Henry covers how authoring tools can help make vast amounts of content more accessible with less effort.
